Good day. This is Sultana Al-Qahtani with the Sahel Desk.

Bottom line: since the previous briefing, the system identified 3 new event(s), 0 materially updated event(s), and 0 event(s) with new corroboration. The leading change is a attack signal involving Africa Corps/Wagner around Mali.

New event 1: attack involving Africa Corps/Wagner in Mali. 1 monitored source across FR reporting. In Mali, at least 100 Russian soldiers and five mercenaries killed in a jihadist attack, according to a latest report by Le Monde.fr Confidence is moderate; details remain subject to revision.

New event 2: security operation involving State in Dioura. 1 monitored source across FR reporting. The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko This Saturday Confidence is low; details remain subject to revision.

New event 3: security operation involving State in Djenné, Sévaré, Ber, Bamako. 1 monitored source across FR reporting. Targeted operations conducted south-east of Djenné, north-west of Sévaré and in Ber Bamako, 19 September 2026 – The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are continuing their mission to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Confidence is moderate; details remain subject to revision.

IS Sahel has no extracted candidate events in either seven-day window. State has 5 extracted candidate events in the latest seven-day window, up from zero in the preceding window.

Analytic note: reporting volume, fused candidate events, and independently verified incidents are different measures. Source claims and unresolved contradictions remain attributed to their underlying reporting.

Nothing further to report at this time.
